package.name: nros_board_mps3_an536_freertos
package.description:
FreeRTOS board support for nano-ros on the ARM MPS3-AN536 (Cortex-R52).
phase-348 W2: this file exists so the provider is DISCOVERABLE — the `nano_ros_provides` export below is what a source-time scan reads. What it lowers to is declared in the sibling `nros-board.toml` descriptor, which is read only when this provider is the one selected.
Added by phase-375 W6 (RFC-0064 R5 D5), late. This board landed in phase-385 with a descriptor and no announcement, and nothing said so, because `check-provider-announcements.py` skipped any descriptor whose package.xml was absent — the migration ratchet outliving the migration. It was the newest board in the tree and the only one still unannounced.
